QuestInfo.0: #rProfession Grand Opening Quest\n#k(Available until Jan 31st, 2011)#k\nYou're a Lv #r10#k Accessory Crafting already? Go see Master #bIntaglio#k.
QuestInfo.1: What kind of gift could #bIntaglio#k have for you?

0.0: Y-you've got...a wonderful glow about you, #h0#! Is it...could it be... My little student, all grown up into a charming master Jeweler! Oh, I'm moved! I'm touched! I'm...but I forget myself! You deserve a gift!

yes.0: Oh... Where did I put it? Give me a moment.

no.0: Oh, don't spurn my gifts to you! I'll keep it until #rJanuary 31, 2011#k, so speak with me before then.

1.0: The gift is...my heart! \nOh, but I tease. This Recipe will allow you to summon beautiful angels to assist the master Jeweler who crafts it. You are now my equal, and I shall always count you as my closest friend...
